meta.title: CV - Ruben Alvarez
meta.description: Résumé of Ruben Alvarez, Head of Software Development based in Madrid. AI-assisted product delivery with OpenSpec, TypeScript, DDD and hexagonal architecture.

name: Ruben Alvarez
title: Head of Software Development · AI-assisted delivery
profile: I lead **product development at Uniendo Nodos** with an **AI-assisted, spec-driven** workflow: the AI implements and people steer the cycle — specify, design, review, validate and ship. This is not a hunch: we **measure it against our own track record** and we budget from those numbers. I bring almost twenty years split between **hands-on development**, the **technical leadership** of two companies I co-founded and **agile coaching** — exactly the mix this moment calls for, because the bottleneck is no longer typing code but **deciding well, slicing work into shippable pieces and verifying what gets delivered**. I work with **solid practices** — TDD, DDD, continuous delivery — and I enjoy looking for **better ways to do things**; today that means building the **harness** (rules, agents and automations) that lets the team move faster without losing control.

projects.title: Cloud Monitor
projects.shortDescription: Learning application to display the status of cloud servers. Developed using **DotNet Core 8** on the backend, following a **microservices architecture**, **hexagonal architecture**, and **DDD, Repository, and Criteria patterns**. Implemented with **TDD** (Test-Driven Development), starting with a test and then writing the code to pass it.

projects.title: Movi-info
projects.shortDescription: Learning application for movie information management. Developed with **React** and **TypeScript** for the frontend, **DotNet Core 8** for the backend, following a hexagonal architecture and DDD, Repository, and Criteria patterns. It implements automated tests and is containerized with **Docker**.

projects.title: Self-Assessment Data
projects.shortDescription: Web application for processing and visualizing organizational agility self-assessment data. Developed with **ReactJs**, partially implementing a **Hexagonal architecture**. Processes Microsoft Forms Excel files and generates graphical visualizations. **Dockerized** and deployed on a web server.

experience.title: Head of Software Development
responsibilities: I lead product development with an **AI-assisted, spec-driven** workflow (**OpenSpec** + **Claude Code**): the AI implements and the team steers the cycle — specification, design, review, validation and release.

**160 changes delivered in 12.7 weeks** with ~1.25 people (**2.8 – 3.5 h per change**), between **3 and 4 times** the pace of the equivalent hand-written code. These are figures measured on our own repository, not an estimate.
Built the **engineering harness** behind it: in-house rules, *skills* and agents, automated tests, CI/CD and continuous delivery, reusable from one project to the next.

In-house product **Klonup**, built in **TypeScript** (Angular and **Node.js**) with **DDD** and hexagonal architecture on **Google Cloud Platform**: billing with two external payment gateways and a phased execution engine.
In-house **MCP servers** and automations (**n8n**) that bring the same approach to sales and operations: ICP-based prospecting, campaigns, lead *scoring* and content publishing.
Integrations with client systems: ERP **AL** extensions, **Smartsheet** and **Entra ID** SSO.
I budget and scope projects from **measured data** on our own track record — hours per *change*, share of corrective work and an explicit contingency line — instead of guessing.
